title: OF MODELS AND TIN MEN- A BEHAVIOURAL ECONOMICS STUDY OF PRINCIPAL-AGENT PROBLEMS IN AI ALIGNMENT USING LARGE-LANGUAGE MODELS
reasoning: The paper examines AI alignment by investigating how LLMs handle conflicts between different 'principals' (e.g., a corporate entity with ethical guidelines vs. a user). It specifically uses scenarios involving moral values and ethical decision-making, such as choosing between a Nazi propaganda film and a romantic comedy, to evaluate model behavior.
